name: compass
description: A side pane that tracks the session's goal, decisions, hypotheses or findings grouped into topics, and one explanatory visual.

updaterModel.title: Updater model
updaterModel.description: Which model rewrites the compass after a turn: sonnet-low and haiku run a separate small completion over the new messages; fork asks the session model over the whole transcript (cache-friendly, costs more).

sessionType.title: Session type
sessionType.description: What kind of session this is, which sets the section title and the kinds of items it lists. auto lets the updater infer it from the conversation; any other value fixes it.

trackOpenQuestions.title: Track open questions
trackOpenQuestions.description: Also list questions the conversation raised and left unanswered.

trackRejected.title: Track rejected options
trackRejected.description: Also list options that were considered and dropped, with a one-line reason.

autoOpen.title: Open pane at session start
autoOpen.description: Open the Compass pane when a session starts. The engine seats an unasked pane only from 144 terminal columns.
